title: Test superposition.
prompt: Let f(x) = x² on ℝ. What is f(1 + 1) − [f(1) + f(1)]?

feedback.pass: 4 − 2 = 2. One failed instance is enough to refute the universal superposition requirement for this map.
feedback.fail: Square after adding in the first term, but square before adding in the second.
